eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Santa Cruz, AZ; at 8:20 PM on AUG 27, 2025 Effective until 6:20 AM AUG 28, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. A Silver Alert has been issued for Santa Cruz County. Santa Cruz County Sheriff is looking for Jacob Egelhoff last seen on foot wearing green shorts, blue and red checkered shirt, and black shoes. If you have contact with this Silver Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
